label: Norepinephrine
summary: Vasopressor with strong alpha-1 and some beta-1 effect. It is the commonly preferred first-line vasopressor in cardiogenic shock.

levers.why: Alpha-1 vasoconstriction raises systemic vascular resistance and MAP.
Modest beta-1 stimulation adds some inotropy.
A higher diastolic pressure supports coronary perfusion.

nursingPriorities: Infuse through a central line when possible; for peripheral use follow the facility protocol and check the site often for extravasation.
Titrate to the ordered MAP target, and watch for arrhythmias and cold, ischemic fingers and toes.
